schema.title: Custom Search Input
schema.description: Input schema for searching Facebook data using Apify Actor.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: The search term to look for.

resultsCount.title: Number of results
resultsCount.description: Number of search results to retrieve. If not set, only a few of the first posts will be returned. Note: Free-plan users can retrieve up to 100 posts per search query.

searchType.title: Search Type
searchType.description: What kind of posts you'd like to search for. Defaults to platform’s default if not specified.

location.title: Location
location.description: Limit posts to a given **pinned** location. Enter a location name or a Facebook Location ID. For names, the first result from the Facebook location dropdown is selected. For example, entering 'Alaska' will result in 'Anchorage, Alaska'.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Get posts starting from given date (YYYY-MM-DD).

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Get posts ending on given date (YYYY-MM-DD).

query.title: Search Query
query.description: Keywords to search for Facebook posts.

recent_posts.title: Recent Posts Only
recent_posts.description: Whether to only search for recent posts.

location_uid.title: Location UID
location_uid.description: Location unique identifier for filtering posts.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Start date for filtering posts (format: yyyy-mm-dd).

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: End date for filtering posts (format: yyyy-mm-dd).

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of posts to fetch.

schema.title: Facebook Search Input
schema.description: Search Facebook by keyword across posts, pages, groups, people, videos, and events.

query.title: Search Query
query.description: The keyword or phrase to search for on Facebook.

search_type.title: Search Type
search_type.description: What type of Facebook content to search for.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Maximum number of unique results to return. The actor automatically deduplicates results. 5 is a quick sample for testing — for real analysis use 50 to 200. Costs $0.0026 per result. Free Apify plans are capped at 20 results.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Filter results from this date (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no date filter.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Filter results until this date (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty for no date filter.

recent_posts.title: Recent Posts First
recent_posts.description: Sort results by most recent instead of relevance. May return less relevant results.

location_uid.title: Location UID
location_uid.description: Facebook location UID to filter results by geographic area. Leave empty for global search.

schema.title: Input schema for the apify_project actor.

categories.title: 🔍 Search terms
categories.description: Add one or multiple keywords. You can add the keywords one by one, or use the Bulk edit section to pull them from a prepared list.

locations.title: 📍 Location (applied to each search term)
locations.description: Free text location definition. Just add a name of a country, city or province.

resultsLimit.title: 💯 Up to [number] of search results
resultsLimit.description: Set the number of results you expect for the entire run (if this limit is not set, as many results as possible are returned).

search_type.description: Which types of results search for
